scope: Temporary cash assistance under the Family Investment Program: who may be eligible (s 5-308(a)(2), (3), (h)), the conditions of s 5-312(b), exemptions from work activity (s 5-308(b)), good cause for child support (s 5-308(d), (e), as facts), the most work activity that may be required (s 5-308(a)(6)), education as work activity (s 5-308(a)(4)), the time limits (s 5-313), SSI excluded (s 5-315(b)), sanctions and the 30-day rules (s 5-312(e), two regulative rules), transitional assistance (s 5-312(f)). The grant amount and the income and resource tests are in COMAR (not deposited) and are inputs.
seat: the applicant for, or recipient of, temporary cash assistance (parent, caretaker relative or pregnant individual)
